```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

if (!requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("dplyr")
if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ggplot2")
if (!requireNamespace("tidyr", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("tidyr")
if (!requireNamespace("pheatmap", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pheatmap")

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)
```

```{r}

exprs_data <- read.csv("data.csv", row.names = 1)
labels_data <- read.csv("labels.csv", row.names = 1)

df <- cbind(labels_data, exprs_data)

dim_df <- dim(df)
print(paste("Liczba próbek (wierszy):", dim_df[1], "| Liczba genów/cech (kolumn):", dim_df[2]))

df <- df[, 1:51] # Kolumna 1 to Class, kolumny 2-51 to geny
str(df[, 1:10])

head(df[, 1:6], 10)
tail(df[, 1:6], 5)
```


```{r}
df$Class <- as.factor(df$Class)

colnames(df) <- toupper(colnames(df))

df$GENE_1[c(10, 45, 120)] <- NA

df_sorted <- df %>% arrange(desc(GENE_2))

df_brca_high <- df %>% filter(CLASS == "BRCA" & GENE_3 > 5.0)
```


```{r}
print(paste("Liczba NA przed imputacją:", sum(is.na(df$GENE_1))))

mean_gene1 <- mean(df$GENE_1, na.rm = TRUE)
df$GENE_1[is.na(df$GENE_1)] <- mean_gene1

print(paste("Liczba NA po imputacji:", sum(is.na(df$GENE_1))))
```


```{r}
eda_summary <- df %>%
  filter(GENE_4 > 0) %>%                                 
  select(CLASS, GENE_1, GENE_2, GENE_3) %>%             
  mutate(RATIO_1_2 = GENE_1 / (GENE_2 + 0.01)) %>%       
  group_by(CLASS) %>%                                  
  summarise(                                            
    AVG_GENE_1 = mean(GENE_1),
    AVG_GENE_2 = mean(GENE_2),
    SAMPLE_COUNT = n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(AVG_GENE_1))                        

print(eda_summary)
```


```{r}
get_mode <- function(v) {
  uniqv <- unique(v)
  uniqv[which.max(tabulate(match(v, uniqv)))]
}

gene_stats <- list(
  Minimum = min(df$GENE_5),
  Maksimum = max(df$GENE_5),
  Srednia = mean(df$GENE_5),
  Mediana = median(df$GENE_5),
  Moda = get_mode(round(df$GENE_5, 1)), 
  Odchylenie_Standardowe = sd(df$GENE_5),
  Kwartyle = quantile(df$GENE_5)
)
print(gene_stats)

print("Tabela częstości próbek nowotworowych:")
print(table(df$CLASS))
```

```{r}
anova_result <- aov(GENE_1 ~ CLASS, data = df)
summary(anova_result)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = CLASS, y = GENE_1, fill = CLASS)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Rozkład ekspresji GENE_1 dla poszczególnych typów nowotworów",
       x = "Typ nowotworu", y = "Poziom ekspresji (RNA-Seq)")

ggplot(df, aes(x = GENE_2, fill = CLASS)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Gęstość ekspresji GENE_2", x = "Ekspresja", y = "Gęstość")

ggplot(df, aes(x = GENE_1, y = GENE_2, color = CLASS)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Koekspresja: GENE_1 vs GENE_2", x = "GENE_1", y = "GENE_2")
```  
  
```{r}  

filter_by_variance <- function(data_matrix, min_sd) {
  num_data <- data_matrix %>% select(where(is.numeric))
  

  highly_variable_genes <- num_data[, apply(num_data, 2, sd) > min_sd]
  return(highly_variable_genes)
}

hvg_data <- filter_by_variance(df, 3.0)
print(paste("Liczba genów o wysokiej zmienności (SD > 3.0):", ncol(hvg_data)))
```


```{r}

num_genes <- min(20, ncol(hvg_data))
heatmap_matrix <- as.matrix(hvg_data[1:40, 1:num_genes])

rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- df$CLASS[1:40] 

heatmap_matrix_scaled <- scale(heatmap_matrix)

pheatmap(heatmap_matrix_scaled,
         main = "Profil ekspresji wysoce zmiennych genów (Z-score)",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50),
         fontsize_row = 8,
         fontsize_col = 8,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = TRUE)
```
